name: Metaprogramming preserves the semantics owned by earlier chapters

applicability.reason: Supported. C002 forbids this chapter from redefining ordinary dispatch, Method identity, Contract algebra, async scheduling, native handles, tokens or serialization, so the row compares those observables BEFORE and AFTER the META subsystem loads. The fixture is a real package, which supplies the package metadata half the earlier reason named, and its Module body loads Module composition, a decorator, capability metadata and reflection between the two snapshots. Ordinary dispatch, the reflected Method selector, Contract count, canonical serialization and the resolved package identity are all unchanged, which is what C002 requires.
